::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_07b — OrgPath and Purview Risk & AI Governance
:::


::: {.callout-note}
A second supplement to chapter 7. Book 07 governed the user-facing policy plane — labels, DLP, retention, and eDiscovery scoped by Adaptive Policy Scopes that follow people through every move. Book 07a governed the data plane — Fabric Domains, OneLake security, and Purview catalog enrichment. This supplement covers the half both leave untouched: the **risk-facing and AI-facing** Purview solutions — Insider Risk Management, Communication Compliance, and DSPM for AI / Copilot data posture — where organizational position decides not who can *act on* data but who is *watched*, *supervised*, and *exposed through AI*. OrgPath is the join key across all three; the privacy guardrails these solutions demand and the GCC-Moderate boundary caveats are called out explicitly. Companion to the [Old AD vs New EntraID foundational reference](../learning/old-ad-vs-new-entra-reference.qmd).
:::
